reason: A read-only MCP integration that lets DSH search a local Zotero library, inspect bibliographic metadata and indexed PDF text, and export references as BibTeX for citation workflows.

summaries.zh: 将本地 Zotero 文献库接入 DSH，支持检索文献、读取元数据和已索引 PDF 全文，并导出 BibTeX 引用。
summaries.en: Connects a local Zotero library to DSH for literature search, metadata and indexed PDF full-text reading, and BibTeX export.

capabilities: Searches a local Zotero library by keywords, collections, or year
Reads bibliographic metadata and attachment lists
Reads indexed PDF full text from Zotero
Exports selected references as BibTeX text
